tools.name: search_corpus
tools.description: Semantic search over 24M+ biomedical journal abstracts (more than 20 million of them in PubMed). Finds papers by MEANING, not keywords. Returns papers ranked by a hybrid relevance score (semantic similarity + lexical overlap + citation quality + recency) with abstracts, PMIDs, metadata and DOI links

tools.name: search_corpus_keyword
tools.description: KEYWORD/Boolean search over the same 24M+ biomedical abstracts, matching EXACT TERMS rather than meaning. Use this instead of search_corpus when the query contains specific identifiers — gene symbols (TP53, BRCA1), variants (p.Gly12Asp, c.35G>A, rs334), accessions, clinical-trial IDs (NCT…), cell li

tools.name: get_papers
tools.description: Looks up papers in the RBAi Scholar corpus by PubMed ID or DOI, up to 50 per call. Returns each paper found with its title, authors, year, journal, abstract, DOI, PMID, citation count and open-access status, and lists the identifiers that are not in the corpus.

tools.name: find_similar_papers
tools.description: Finds the papers in the RBAi Scholar corpus closest in meaning to one paper already in it, given by PubMed ID or DOI. Compares that paper's stored embedding with the corpus and ranks by similarity plus citation count and recency, leaving the paper itself out. Takes year, open-access, citation, type,

tools.name: get_references
tools.description: Lists the papers that one paper in the RBAi Scholar corpus cites, given by PubMed ID or DOI, limited to the cited papers that are themselves in the corpus, the most similar to the paper first (by their stored embeddings). Returns each with its title, authors, year, journal, abstract, DOI, PMID, cita

tools.name: get_citing_papers
tools.description: Lists the papers in the RBAi Scholar corpus that cite one paper, given by PubMed ID or DOI: the 500 most cited of them, the most similar to the paper first (by their stored embeddings).
